input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.
It looks like my messaging app currently cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next to get this working again?
Yes, please go ahead and check my phone’s cellular service status and settings. Let me know what you need me to do next.
Looking at my phone’s status bar, I see that Airplane Mode is currently enabled. Also, it appears that my phone is not detecting a SIM card at the moment. What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode and reinserted my SIM card. My phone now detects the SIM card, and I see a poor signal with 2G showing in the status bar. Mobile data is still disabled. What should I do next?
I’ve turned on mobile data, but my phone is still showing a poor signal on 2G, and I’m still unable to send MMS messages. The network technology hasn’t changed from 2G. What should I try next?
I changed the network mode to prefer 4G/5G, and now my phone shows an excellent signal with 5G and mobile data enabled. However, I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What should I try next?

I checked my APN settings, and it looks like the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. Should I go ahead and reset the APN settings to default, or do you want to provide the correct MMSC URL for me to enter?
I’ve reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone, but I’m still unable to send MMS messages. Is there anything else I should try?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my phone, so that doesn’t seem to be causing the issue. What should I try next?
I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it already has access to SMS, storage, and phone. What else can we try to fix the MMS issue?
Thank you for letting me know. I’ll wait for the human agent.
Thank you! I’ll wait for the agent to join.
Thank you for your help so far. I’ll wait for the human agent to assist me further.
Thanks again! I appreciate your help. I’ll wait for the human agent now. Have a great day as well! ###TRANSFER###
